import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import norm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(x):
    if not isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        raise TypeError("x must be a numpy.ndarray")

    real_part = norm.pdf(x, loc=0, scale=1)
    imaginary_part = norm.pdf(x, loc=2, scale=2)
    complex_distribution = real_part + 1j * imaginary_part

    flat_x = x.ravel()
    flat_real = real_part.ravel()
    flat_imag = imaginary_part.ravel()

    if flat_x.size > 0:
        order = np.argsort(flat_x)
        plt.figure()
        plt.plot(flat_x[order], flat_real[order], label="Real part: N(0, 1)")
        plt.plot(flat_x[order], flat_imag[order], label="Imaginary part: N(2, 2)")
        plt.xlabel("x")
        plt.ylabel("Density")
        plt.title("Complex Distribution from Two Gaussian Distributions")
        plt.legend()
        plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return complex_distribution
